Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording for this, but you can list me as the claimant on the file.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Sugar Land, Texas. I had just pulled into a space near the entrance
and was getting my bags out of the back seat.
Q: What hpapened next?
A: I heard a horn and then a loud bang. A pickup backing out of the row next to me hit the rear quarter panel of my
car. I didn't see it coming because my view was blocked by the cart corral.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: Briefly. He got out and apologized, and he said he thought the lane was clear. He gave me his insurance card, and
I took a photo of it.
Q: Are you currently receiving medical treatment?
A: Yes. I went to urgent care that afternoon. They diagnosed me with a concussion. I've had headaches, trouble
concentrating, and I've been sensitive to light. My doctor has me resting from screens and driving for now.
Q: Have you missed work because of your injuries?
A: I've been out for about two weeks. I work from a laptop, and I can't stay focused long enough to do it right.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having symptoms, and I'm working with my doctor on the recovery plan. I'll send you the medical
records once I have them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
